messages:
deploy-bot: starting helm upgrade for release inference-controller chart=infra/inference-controller v1.9.0 -> v1.10.0 in cluster=prod-eu-west
maya: kicking this off now, contains a post-upgrade Job that migrates gpupool CRs (schema conversion + finalizer change). I'll monitor.
ian: seeing the post-upgrade job stuck in Pending on nodeSelector? pods show `ErrImagePull`?
maya: logs on the Job pod show webhook conversion errors, not image issues. snippet: `rpc error: code = Unknown desc = conversion webhook failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`
nora: :eyes: that usually means the CRD's conversion webhook CABundle is stale or cert-manager didn't renew the signing cert. Did the cert-manager rollout just happen in the same wave?
ash (sre-bot): alert: CRD conversion failures for gpupools.redwood.io observed at 2026-03-18T10:00Z (rate 12/min)
ash (sre-bot): cluster job 405983 triggered: helm release inference-controller post-upgrade Job `migrate-gpupools` failing due to webhook errors
ash (ash): quick check: `kubectl get crd gpupools.redwood.io -o jsonpath='{.spec.conversion.webhook.clientConfig.caBundle}' | wc -c` => 0 (empty)
ian: hmm, why empty? We have a cert in `cert-manager` namespace `gpupool-webhook-cert`. Was that secret deleted by GitOps diff?
maya: our GitOps commit earlier replaced cert-manager chart with pinned older version (PR #2046). Could be related. Terraform also applied a gpupool finalizer change concurrently (pipeline #build-712). Possible race.
nora: options: (1) patch CRD to temporarily remove conversion webhook/ set conversion strategy to `None` to let Job progress, (2) patch the CRD caBundle with cert from secret, (3) run helm upgrade with `--no-hooks` and handle migration offline. Any objections?
ian: (3) risky because then resources the hook expects won't be migrated and release will be out-of-sync. (1) is fastest but risky for API compatibility. (2) is surgical: copy CA from secret and patch CRD.
ash (ash): trying 2 now: 
```
kubectl -n cert-manager get secret gpupool-webhook-cert -o jsonpath='{.data.ca\.crt}' | base64 -d | kubectl patch crd gpupools.redwood.io --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"conversion":{"webhook":{"clientConfig":{"caBundle":"'$(base64 | tr -d '\n')'"}}}}}'
```
maya: careful with inline base64 in one-liner, might break quoting in shell. I'll paste the CA bundle with a tempfile.
ash (ash): updated CRD caBundle to cert from `gpupool-webhook-cert`. Watching job.
ian: job logs now show `200 OK` from webhook, migration step started.
nora: :thumbsup: progress. Any downstream Terraform/state issues from the earlier finalizer change?
maya: Terraform apply #712 did add a `managedBy: terraform` annotation and set `spec.finalizers` ordering, which left some gpupool CRs with unexpected finalizer entries. The migration job handles reordering, but it had been blocked by the webhook error.
ash (ash): post-upgrade job completed successfully at 1995001380. Helm reported `upgrade complete`.
maya: confirmed release inference-controller v1.10.0 now in prod-eu-west, pods healthy, inference-serving queue steady.
ian: follow-up action: open a PR to our GitOps repo to ensure cert-manager chart version isn't skipped during upgrades; add a preflight check for `crd.conversion.clientConfig.caBundle` non-empty for validated CRDs.
nora: also add a short runbook step to avoid running Terraform gpupool-finalizer changes in the same window as chart upgrades that run CRD conversion hooks.
maya: creating an incident note and tagging infra-release team, will include timeline + commands used.
ash (sre-bot): deploy-bot: recorded release event https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/405983 for traceability
ian: retrospective: we should treat CRD conversion CABundle as a critical preflight check in CI and stop releases if it's empty. Low friction to implement.
maya: agreed — I'll file the RFC and a quick CI job.
nora: thanks all, closing the thread once the PRs are up.
maya: thanks for the quick assist.
